parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description:
The service instance ID.

>  You must specify either `ServiceInstanceId` or `MarketInstanceId`. Otherwise, the operation fails.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest get-service-instance --service-instance-id si-d6ab3a63ccbb4b170000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --market-instance-id 70400059 --region cn-hangzhou
